title: Brass bands and funerals
summary: He led a brass band when he wished and played funerals for gamblers and friends.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Jazz funerals: dirges, hot return, second line

blocks.x: Did you ever play... Did you play many parades in New Orleans?
Yeah, when I felt like it. When you felt like it? I had a brass band. I just called guys together. What'd you call your brass band? Kid or his brass band. Had my signs all over.
Oh, yeah? Did you play funerals?
Yeah. Sometimes I was so tired, I wouldn't. I'd turn them down. I'd turn them up. Do we have any of those barbers for your chips? Uh-huh.
What about putting some out in two bowls?

Most of the funerals, I used to play for all the gamblers, you know. I'm a hustler, you know. I used to support all my dancers, you see. When a friend would die. They wouldn't give a guy a dollar when he was hungry, but when he died, they put up five dollars a beer. Yeah. You getting my point?

Maybe they, in a theory, I'll be glad when you're dead, you rest for you. Yeah. Yeah. What was the biggest funeral that you remember? I mean, the, you know, the most, the most to do. You forgot the bus?
